# SatByte 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

```blitzbasic
SatByte:Int32 value:Float32
```

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Byte (-128 to 127) and stops at -128 and 127 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. [Byte](Byte) does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

```blitzbasic
Print SatByte(100)
Print SatByte(200)
Print SatByte(-200)
```

```text
100
127
-128
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.
